description: Find and compare public Mazadat vehicle auctions in Saudi Arabia. Search by make, model, condition, closing time, and estimated total budget; view vehicle photos and auction details; and estimate bid costs including applicable tax and auction fees. Explore sampled market summaries, public fee information, and promotions. Auction views support Arabic and English. No sign-in is required. The app is read-only and cannot register users, place bids, make payments, or access private account information.
